title: Portable Handheld Mini Turbo Fan In Outdoor USB Rechargeable Ice Cooling Fans W LED Display Fan US Logistics Only For USPS.TK TMEU Only For Self-pickup
body_html:
Features

【Turbine Blades, More Concentrated Wind Power】 Portable turbo fan adopts 5-blade design, with high-speed brushless motor, providing a maximum wind speed of up to 33ft/s. 13550 RPM, brings you a strong and stable wind experience

【Instant Ice Cooling】 Our Handheld fan utilizes semiconductor cooling technology to deliver a refreshing cool breeze within 3s to your face, neck and back.

【Speed Adjustable】 ① A single click cycles through the fixed-speed settings ( Speed 01 → 25 → 50 → 75 → 100).

② While working, a long press enabling seamless Speed Up from Level 1 to 100 for ultra-precise airflow customization, long press again to slow down.

③ While working, double-click quickly to turn on the cooling function, the cooling icon ❆ will light up. Double-click again to turn off the cooling function, the cooling icon ❆will turn off.

【LED Digital Display】 This portable fan is equipped with a high-definition digital display screen, which can show the current wind speed and remaining battery power, so you no longer need to worry about the remaining power of the fan. When the battery of this mini fan is low, you can arrange for charging in advance, ensuring a cool companion on every trip.

【Portable & 90° Foldable】 Ultra-compact 6.4*2.3 inches design and weighing only 0.46 lbs, this portable fan can be easily put into your pocket or bag. Its 90° foldable design adapts to your needs. Use it as a handheld fan on the go, place it on your desk as a stable desk fan, hang it around your neck hands-free with the included lanyard.

 

Speed Modes:  1 - 100 Stepless Adjustment & 5 speed fixed-speed adjustment

Battery Type:  Build-in battery

Material: ABS + PC + Electronic component

Size: 6.4*2.3 inches

Weight: 0.46 lbs

Color: Dark Gray

Battery capacity：2000 milliampere

 

 

Precautions

1. When the fan is working, the fan blades rotate at high speed. it is forbidden to insert fingers into them to avoid danger.

2. This product is not a children's toy. Children under 12 years old should use it under the supervision of a guardian.

 

Package included

1 x Handheld Folding Fan

1 x Landyard

1 x USB Cable
